children: Shares of Rithm Capital rose after the company's third-quarter earnings came in ahead of analyst expectations.
Shares rose 6.7% to $9.26 on Friday. The stock is down 15% year to date.
The alternative asset manager reported a profit of $253.3 million, or 38 cents a share, compared with a profit of $56.3 million, or 4 cents a share, in the second quarter.
On an adjusted basis, the company reported earnings available for distribution of 55 cents a share. Analysts surveyed by FactSet were expecting 50 cents a share.
Revenue grew to $1.76 billion, up from $1.28 billion in the previous quarter. Analysts were expecting $1.47 billion in revenue.
